parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat of a folding chair, typically made of durable plastic. It is flat and slightly contoured for comfort.
parts.Functional_description: The seat supports the user's weight and provides a comfortable sitting surface. It is attached to the folding frame and may pivot slightly when the chair is folded or unfolded.
parts.Movement_description: The seat can move relative to the frame during folding and unfolding but remains fixed when the chair is in use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the folding chair, made of tubular steel for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support, connects the seat and backrest, and allows the chair to fold for storage or transport.
parts.Movement_description: The base body includes pivot joints that enable folding and unfolding motion while maintaining rigidity when locked in the open position.
